FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_KNIGHT_BADGE.title: Knight's Badge
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_KNIGHT_BADGE.descript: The first time you fully block an attack each turn, gain 1 Honor.
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_KNIGHT_BADGE.flavor: A tarnished knight's badge engraved with an ancient oath.
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_GAUNTLET.title: Gauntlet
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_GAUNTLET.description: At the start of each combat, gain 6 Plated Armor.
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_GAUNTLET.flavor: Heavy metal gauntlets that shield the brave from every impact.
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_GLORY_MEDAL.title: Glory Medal
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_GLORY_MEDAL.descripti: Increase Honor limit by 2. At the start of your turn, if you have more than 5 Honor, gain 1 Strength.
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_GLORY_MEDAL.flavor: A radiant medal, a testament to countless moments of guarding with your shield.
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_TRAINING_SWORD.title: Training Sword
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_TRAINING_SWORD.descri: At the end of your turn, if you have at least 3 Honor, upgrade a random card in your discard pile.
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_TRAINING_SWORD.flavor: A well-worn wooden sword, its hilt covered in fine nicks.
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_LOST_LIGHT_SWORD.desc: Whenever you spend Honor, deal 3 damage to a random enemy for each Honor spent.
FOREVE_RELIC_OGIER_LOST_LIGHT_SWORD.flav: A holy sword that has lost its luster, though a faint light still clings to its edge.
FOREVE_RELIC_DORE_NUTRITION_TANK.title: Nutrition Tank
FOREVE_RELIC_DORE_NUTRITION_TANK.descrip: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Regeneration.
FOREVE_RELIC_DORE_NUTRITION_TANK.flavor: A glass tank filled with pale green fluid, keeping living tissue active.
FOREVE_RELIC_DORE_TECHNICAL_MANUAL.title: Technical Manual
FOREVE_RELIC_DORE_TECHNICAL_MANUAL.flavo: An old manual of surgical procedures and energy formulas, its pages curled at the edges.
